title: Problem with hot addWidget

comments.body:
Hi @Sirbuland, thanks for getting this to our attention, this indeed is a bug, which we managed to reduce thanks to your example. It's happening because 3.5.1 we made a change in how we deal with default values coming from URLs. 

Can you try this out in 3.4.0 of InstantSearch.js? You can use yarn resolutions to force that version to be used.

Hi @Haroenv !
Thanks for your reply. I'll try using version 3.4.0 and update here about its results.

Hi @Haroenv !
Its still problematic with version 3.4.0. It do not give errors but the sort by is not still working fine. This widget disappears (dropdown menu) after some delay i-e 2-3 seconds. When page loads it is like this: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/16lTszOQHoNhUTPdVe63CmUmqpt-wK0G_/view?usp=sharing](dropdownPresent)

After some time span it disappears: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EIGzJDuUNK9CdMZhXQccle73MXjoLRUk/view?usp=sharing](dropdownDisappears)

This was also happening previously when created this issue, but also give errors on browser's console. Now there is no error on console.

I shifted to previous version of instantsearch.js by using resolutions in package.json.

```
"resolutions": {
 "instantsearch.js": "3.4.0",
},
```
Sorry for not getting back here, but I think this has been fixed since. Please feel free to open a new issue with reproduction if this still happens now
